compliancePosture: Aggregate region-level statistics only; no individual sold prices; every figure n>=5. Cite figures verbatim.

angles.headline: 33% of active Whitby listings have cut their asking price
angles.whySurprising: Highest price-cut share of the 15 markets tracked today.

angles.headline: The typical active Hamilton listing has now sat 61 days
angles.whySurprising: Longest median true days-on-market of the markets tracked today.

angles.headline: Richmond Hill is sitting at 6.2 months of supply
angles.whySurprising: Most inventory of the 15 markets tracked today — ≈4–6 months is balanced, and above that tilts toward buyers.

angles.headline: A 1-bed in Ottawa grosses about 6.9% rental yield
angles.whySurprising: Best gross rental yield of the markets tracked today (1-bed).
